title: Pokéstar Studios' cut-in scripts: res/pokewood/cutins.json
description: ARCID_POKEWOOD_CUTIN_SCRIPT (a/2/7/5), the cut-ins that pokewood_cutin.c plays in the movies' battles after some scenes. tools/data/pokewood_cutin_data.py packs it.

scripts.description: Script n is the cut-in of sCutins[n], which PokewoodCutin_HasCutin and Cutin_FindScript look up by the movie and the scene

movie.description: The movie, as sCutins has it; the code doesn't read it

scene.description: The scene after which the cut-in plays, as sCutins has it; the code doesn't read it

unk04.description: 1 to 3; the code doesn't read it

male.description: The resources the cut-in loads first for a male player (header halfwords 3 to 6)

female.description: And for a female player (7 to 10)

steps.description: The steps in order; the cut-in ends after the last

resources.description: Files of ARCID_POKEWOOD_CUTIN_GRA (res/graphics/pokewood_cutin_gra/) by number, which Cutin_LoadResources loads for the cut-in's CUTIN_ACTOR_COUNT actors

step.description: A command of sCommands and the arguments its handler reads; the packer checks that each command has its own

command.description: Cutin_CmdMove: move an actor between the screen's center and 256 pixels from it, out when it is at the center and in otherwise; Cutin_CmdMoveDist: move it a distance from where it is; Cutin_CmdSetVisible; Cutin_CmdNudge: move it 10 pixels and back; Cutin_CmdLoadResources: replace the resources; Cutin_CmdWait; Cutin_CmdPrintMessage: print a message and wait for it; Cutin_CmdViewEffect: hide the message window and wait; Cutin_CmdPlaySE; Cutin_CmdWaitSound: wait until no sound plays; Cutin_CmdStopSound

actor.description: For move, move_dist, set_visible and nudge: the actor, whose animation of the same number move, move_dist and nudge play

motion.description: For move and move_dist: at a constant speed or speeding up (sMoveFuncs)

direction.description: For move and move_dist, any of these (Cutin_GetCenterMove); for nudge, up, down, left or right (sNudgeFuncs)

frames.description: For move and move_dist: how many frames the move takes; for wait: one less than the frames it waits

distance.description: For move_dist: how many pixels, along each axis of a diagonal move about 1.24 times this (a BUG of Cutin_GetDistMove)

visible.description: For set_visible: whether the actor shows

male.description: For load_resources: the resources for a male player

female.description: For load_resources: and for a female player

step.description: For print_message: the step of the scene's messages (BtlStudioScene, the scene's messages in res/pokewood/movies/<n>/movie.json), 0 to 9, or 10 and more for the choice the player made

kind.description: For print_message: which of the scene's two kinds of messages; for a choice, 0 for its message and any other for its message2

arg0.description: An argument the command doesn't read, when it isn't 0

arg1.description: An argument the command doesn't read, when it isn't 0
